description: SFLOW semi-implicit step with the coupled non-hydrostatic pressure (A 210 12, A 220 3) and a moving surface pressure (X 10 3, X 400 3: 4 m long, depth-Froude number 1.0, h = 1 m), dx = 0.1 m, dt = 0.025 s (the pressure moves 0.8 cells per step). Upstream solitons form ahead of the pressure.
covers: sixdof_sflow pressure with the semi-implicit step (sflow_press_step: mean of the start and end of the step)
ship_level in the face discharge and the cell update
